title: Sort and filter controls on the Tenant directory
description: Long-running hostels accumulate a large list of vacated tenants that clutter the day-to-day tenant directory. Wardens want to filter to just active tenants and sort by name or room, without scrolling past years of history. Split out from a single broader 'sort/filter everywhere' ticket per Product Owner review (2026-09-03) - the equivalent work for Room/Bed views, Invoices, and Expenses now lives in LODGY-53/54/55 respectively, since each screen's filter semantics and underlying queries are different enough to size and test independently.
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant directory can filter to Active-only (hide vacated) and sort by name or room
Filter/sort state resets sensibly and doesn't silently hide data the warden forgot was filtered

history.note: Added from the v2 feedback session (warden interviews after the v1 field test) and from buried enhancement/limitation notes surfaced while re-reading the full v1 board history.

Narrowed to Tenant directory only - this was scoped too broadly as one ticket spanning four different screens. Room/Bed filtering is now LODGY-53, Invoice date filter+sort is LODGY-54, Expense filter+sort is LODGY-55.

Starting - filter (All/Active) and sort (Name/Room) on the tenant directory. Defaulting the filter to Active-only since that is the complaint, but pairing it with a permanent 'N vacated hidden' line so AC 2 holds - the default helps without anything disappearing silently.

Tenant directory now has a filter (Active only / All, defaulting to Active only) and a sort (Name / Room). AC 2 is handled by never hiding anything silently: both chip rows are always on screen showing the live selection, and whenever the filter drops rows the list is preceded by 'N vacated tenant(s) hidden by this filter', so the default can be the helpful one without a warden losing track of it. Room sort uses roomSortKey(), which orders numeric rooms numerically ('204' before '1005' - a plain string sort gets this backwards), then text-labelled rooms like 'G-2', then tenants with no room at all; name sort is case-insensitive. Added the shared ui/common/FilterChipRow.kt (horizontally scrolling so a long option set never clips) which LODGY-53/54/55 will reuse. TenantDirectoryViewModelTest covers the default filter and its hidden count, switching to ALL, case-insensitive name sort, and the three-way room ordering. testDebugUnitTest green.
